title: Fix LP: #1978152. Basically, pull in ruby-webrick as a runtime dependency in Jammy. More instructions on how to reproduce the issue are in the bug.
description:
Fix LP: #1978152. Basically, pull in ruby-webrick as a runtime dependency in Jammy. More instructions on how to reproduce the issue are in the bug.
